articles.title: Trump refuses to accuse Russia of breaking energy ceasefire, says Ukraine 'hit sites the day before'
articles.summary: According to President Volodymyr Zelensky, the Kremlin attacked six energy facilities on Oct. 11, injuring 33 people across the country.

articles.title: Russia pounds Ukrainian cities, spares energy targets for first time since Trump 'ceasefire'
articles.summary: Russia hammered Ukrainian cities and transport links overnight into Tuesday, killing at least four people in the city of Kharkiv, while appearing to spare energy facilities for the first time since US President Donald Trump announced an "energy ceasefire" at the weekend. It was not clear whether Moscow had deliberately avoided targeting power plants.
